    SELECT u.Id AS UserId,
           u.DisplayName,
           COUNT(b.Id) AS BadgeCount
    FROM users u
    JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(BadgeCount) AS MaxBadges FROM german_badge_counts
),
second_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(BadgeCount) AS SecondBadges
    FROM german_badge_counts
    WHERE BadgeCount < (SELECT MaxBadges FROM max_count)
)
SELECT DisplayName, BadgeCount
FROM german_badge_counts
WHERE BadgeCount = (SELECT SecondBadges FROM second_count)
ORDER BY DisplayName
